# `jouet unwind`

- **Usage:** `jouet unwind [--apply]`

Propose retiring rules that are noisy or often overridden, and unused tasks

Lists your rules and a trusted repository's that the hook ledger shows are overridden at least half the time over five or more firings, fire on a tenth or more of shell calls (at least 20 times), or no longer load. Built-in rules are never proposed. --apply moves your own rules to ~/.config/jouet/rules/retired/ and logs it; a repository's rules change through a PR. It also lists the mise tasks `jouet task apply` added that no agent session has run in the 21 days since, and still run what jouet wrote; --apply removes them with `mise tasks rm`.

## Flags
- **`--apply`** — Retire the proposed rules of yours, and remove the proposed tasks
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
